title: Blue Whale ka Dil Minute Mein Sirf 2 Baar
idea: While diving, a blue whale's heart can slow to about 2 beats per minute. The Short builds to that with its size, weight and elephant-sized tongue.

lines.text: Duniya ke sabse bade jaanwar ka dil minute mein sirf 2 baar dhadakta hai!
Blue whale 30 meter tak lambi hoti hai, cricket pitch se dedh guna!
Wazan? Lagbhag 150 tonne, matlab kareeb 30 haathiyon jitna!
Aur sirf iski jeebh ka wazan ek poore haathi jitna, kareeb 2.5 tonne!
Hamara dil minute mein 60 se 100 baar dhadakta hai, whale ka dive mein sirf 2!
Itna bada dil, phir bhi itni dheemi dhadkan! Aapko sabse shocking kya laga?

facts.claim: A tagged blue whale's heart slowed to 4-8 beats per minute on dives and as low as 2 bpm (Goldbogen et al., PNAS 2019).
The same study measured 2 bpm at its lowest and up to about 37 bpm at the surface.
Blue whales grow up to about 30 m (record about 33.5 m) and weigh up to about 150 metric tonnes.
A blue whale's tongue weighs about 2.5 tonnes, roughly the weight of an elephant.
A cricket pitch is 20.12 m long, so 30 m is about 1.5 pitches (Laws of Cricket).
A normal adult resting heart rate is 60-100 beats per minute (American Heart Association).
